column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for each operations record (e.g., 'OPS0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DisasterEvents(DistRegistry), tying these operations to a disaster (e.g., 'DIST0001').
A VARCHAR(20) referencing DistributionHubs(HubRegistry), associating operations with a particular hub (e.g., 'HUB0001').
An enum (EmergLevel_enum) labeling the emergency level; possible values: 'Black', 'Orange', 'Red', 'Yellow'.
An enum (RespPhase_enum) for the disaster response phase; possible values: 'Reconstruction', 'Recovery', 'Emergency', 'Initial'.
An enum (OpsStatus_enum) showing the operation’s status; values: 'Completed', 'Scaling Down', 'Active', 'Planning'.
A VARCHAR(80) describing the coordination center or command location (e.g., 'Central Ops HQ').
A DATE indicating when operations began (e.g., '2025-04-01').
An INT estimating how many days the operation will last (e.g., 30).
An enum (PriorityRank_enum) defining the priority level; possible values: 'High', 'Medium', 'Low', 'Critical'.
An enum (ResourceAllocState_enum) describing resource allocation; possible values: 'Limited', 'Critical', 'Sufficient'.
An enum (SupplyFlowState_enum) indicating supply chain flow status; possible values: 'Disrupted', 'Stable', 'Strained'.
